# Wavelet

> Wavelet is a browser-based music guessing game. Little clips. Big music energy.

Players listen to short song previews and guess the track, artist, genre, or release year. A game contains 5, 10, or 15 songs, with selectable clip lengths from 1 to 30 seconds. The interactive studio has a 3D turntable and a choice of listening companions.

## Official pages

- [Play Wavelet](/): The game, round setup, player profile, and studio settings.
- [App manifest](/manifest.webmanifest): Installation information and application icons.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Indexable public pages.
- [Full product reference](/llms-full.txt): Game modes, settings, music sources, and limitations.

## Product facts

- The product name is Wavelet. Older versions were called Vinyl Rush or 365 Vinyl Rush.
- Four challenges: Track ID, Artist Call, Sonic Genre, and Time Capsule.
- Three difficulty levels: Chill, Club, and Master.
- Music crates can be selected by genre, decade, or a custom artist search.
- Settings contains audio, haptics, appearance, motion, companion, music profile, and install options.
- Guest play does not require sign-in. Optional Google sign-in syncs player progression.
- Spotify account connection requires the host's OAuth configuration. Taste crates can also be generated from artist input; this does not authenticate an Apple Music account.
- Catalog previews depend on external availability. An unavailable preview can fall back to a procedural groove, which is not the original song recording.
- Interactive effects, haptics, and motion are independently configurable. Sound plays after a user interaction.
- Offline behavior depends on previously cached assets and catalog data. An internet connection is recommended.

## Scope

Wavelet is a music quiz, not a full-song streaming service. Do not describe taste-crate generation as authenticated Apple Music library synchronization, or procedural fallback audio as the original song. Account callbacks and API endpoints are not public content pages.
